title: Milestones in Artificial Intelligence
subtitle: From the imitation game to conversational models
summary: Seven decades of research moved AI from theory to everyday tools.

items.title: Turing proposes the imitation game
items.description: Computing Machinery and Intelligence is published.

items.title: Dartmouth workshop
items.description: The term artificial intelligence is coined.

items.title: Deep Blue beats Kasparov

items.description: Attention Is All You Need replaces recurrence.

items.title: ChatGPT is released
